gloss_text: Transcript: If you have time this afternoon, please call me back. It's not urgent, tomorrow is fine too.
Transcript: Hi, it's me. The book you borrowed yesterday is on the shoe rack at the front. Just pick it up sometime.
Voicemail from an unknown number (transcript): Sorry, is this the neighbourhood office? No urgent matter, no need to call back.
Transcript: Next week's meeting has moved to Wednesday. Just check the calendar, no need to reply now.
From an unsaved number (transcript): Your parcel is at the courier outlet. Please pick it up when you have time, no rush.
Transcript: I cooked rib soup for dinner. Stop by after work if it's on your way, no need to hurry.
BTC rose 4.2% in the last hour and is now around 61,000 USD. This is the volatility alert you set.
Your total asset value changed +1.8% this week; the spot account contributed the most. See the full analysis in the app.
ETH dropped below your alert price of 2,800 USD. Please be aware of market risk.
Today's market has closed. Three of the five coins you follow rose; overall +0.6%.
Your daily interest of 0.12 USDT from the savings product has been credited; details are in your account.
Tonight at 21:30 a large token unlock happens. A token you hold is on this week's list.
Live Caption is paused. Tap Resume to show text again.
The Indonesian speech recognition pack (85 MB) has finished downloading and works offline.
Live Caption uses your device language and works without an internet connection.
Sound detected, transcription started. To stop it, turn off Live Caption in Quick Settings.
Live captions are on. The audio that is playing will appear as text on screen.
Live Caption will automatically pause at 22:00 tonight to save battery.
IMPORTANT: an emergency update is available! You don't need to install it now; it will install automatically over Wi-Fi.
Storage is almost full: 14.2 GB of 15 GB used. Delete unneeded photos and videos to free up space.
Battery is below 20%. Turn on battery saver so the device can be used longer.
Tonight's backup is complete. Your photos and settings are saved safely.
Emergency warning: device storage is almost full. Delete unused apps immediately.
One of your favourite apps now has new features. You can update it any time.

That warung yesterday was really good! The owner even gave us free iced tea, so much fun. Anyone want to go for a morning run tomorrow? They say it'll be sunny but it's supposed to rain in the afternoon. If someone brings a camera, please, I want to upload the photos. Oh, and please transfer this month's dues before Friday, treasurer Mbak Sari asked everything be recorded neatly.

Dear parents, I've put together the list for Monday's study tour: a water bottle, a raincoat, a handkerchief and lunch. Bus money has all been collected. If anyone can take one extra child in their car, please reply in this group by Thursday, so I can arrange the seats on the bus. Thank you very much!

I just saw your night photos, the lighting is amazing. Does anyone know which lens was used? Mine is a standard lens and the results always look a bit soft. If anyone is up for it this weekend, we could go to the riverbank with tripods and try a longer shutter speed. Also check the tide times before leaving so the trip isn't wasted.

Friends, we're starting preparations for the 17 August competitions at the RW field. Gather this Sunday at 9 am at the community hall; we need help painting the flagpole and hanging banners. Anyone who wants to help with food is welcome too. If you can't come, just reply with one word in this group. Thank you all!

[Forward] Apparently from tomorrow the main gate will be closed for road repairs, so vehicles must use the back gate. (From a friend, not yet checked whether it's true.) Please pass it on to nearby neighbours so nobody makes a wasted trip. Apparently a manager at the estate said it; check the notice board for details. No need to panic.

[Forward] Good morning everyone! I hope today goes smoothly and is full of blessings. After you receive this picture, send it to ten people and a big prize will arrive for you today! If you don't send it right away you'll lose out. Share it with all your contacts. Wishing us all good health! I've sent it to twenty people but the prize hasn't come yet.

[Forward] For some days now unknown people have been walking around and knocking on residents' doors. Children and the elderly should not open doors at night without a clear reason. (This info is unverified, please don't spread uncertain information.) Tell the neighbours; someone saw two people in black jackets near block C.

I'm passing on a health article for everyone: apparently drinking eight glasses of warm water a day lowers blood pressure and cures insomnia. The title is catchy, but I haven't found the source, so treat it as a reference only. This Saturday's club meeting goes ahead as usual in the second-floor multipurpose room. Anyone with high blood pressure should check with a doctor first.

To the residents of RW 02: this Saturday at 09.00 there will be a waste-sorting briefing in the middle yard. Children may join. On site we'll hand out reusable shopping bags and small prizes. From next Wednesday the lift will be switched off for about two hours for inspection, so please plan your trips. Thank you for your cooperation. Registration closes Friday evening.

Dear parents, on Monday at 15:30 there will be a parents' meeting in the school hall. We'll discuss the study schedule for the end-of-semester exams and activities during the holidays. Please arrive on time, and if you can't come, let the homeroom teacher know beforehand. After the meeting we'll also explain how to view report cards online. Thank you.

This Sunday at 08.30 we meet at the park entrance to clean up the riverbank. It takes about two hours. Please bring your own gloves and water bottle; rubbish bags will be provided on site. If you're coming, reply 'ikut' (in) in this group so we can count people. A simple lunch together will follow when we finish.

ATTENTION: heavy rain is causing flooding on some roads in this area. Avoid low-lying areas and do not drive through floodwater. If you are in danger call 112 and wait for help on higher ground. Stay away from riverbanks and parking basements, and follow the latest official information.

URGENT: there is a gas leak on floor 3 of Block B. The gas technicians have been called and are on their way. All residents must close the gas regulator straight away, open windows for airflow, don't switch on lights or electrical devices, and don't light a flame. Go out to the yard and gather in the field area. Please make sure the elderly and children are informed too.

EMERGENCY: there is a fire in the building on the east side, residents are being evacuated right now. Blocks 1 to 6, go down the emergency stairs to the north field immediately. Do not use the lift and do not go back for belongings. The fire brigade has arrived; follow the instructions of officers on site. If anyone is still trapped, call 113 or 112 right away.

Guest notice: your guest, Mr. Andi, has arrived at the front gate and is being registered through the access system, expected to finish in 3 minutes. He is carrying a cardboard parcel that the security guard has received. If you have a moment, confirm in the app whether the guest may come up. If not, you can simply decline this registration.

The gate camera detected a courier waiting to be let in. He says he is delivering fresh groceries. You can watch the live feed in the app and choose whether to allow entry. If nothing is done, this notification closes automatically in five minutes and the parcel will be stored in the locker near the entrance.

Your home's visitor log has been updated: this afternoon two people entered the complex, a moving service worker and a maintenance technician. Both are registered. You can see the full details on your device, and for questions please contact the estate office. This is a routine notice and needs no immediate action.
